depends_on: Jacobi triple product (column g.f. = partitions into parts = 0, +-1 mod k+2)
notes: True. Column k counts partitions into parts = 0, +-1 mod m = k+2 (Jacobi triple product). T(n+1) = T(n) iff n+1 has no such partition without 1s iff A(m+1) <= n <= (A+1)(m-1)-2: plateaus [A(m+1), (A+1)(m-1)-1] of length k+1-2A. Level T(A(k+3)) independent of k >= 2A+1 via the bijection am+e -> a(m+1)+e, so equals A210843(A+1) = sum_{B<=A} p3(B) (answers A210843's Euler-transform question). Lean: flat_iff, level_const (Nat.Partition model). Outside Lean: Jacobi triple product step; closed form via A000716 (numerical). Mathlib (rev 56a0058) has only the pentagonal theorem (k=1); triple product for general m not formalized.
